description: S-020-1 early exit (Claude Code 2.1.301), ADR-020 D4, 15 §1.3 launch errors: the CLI wrote a result line with is_error true (error_during_execution, num_turns 0) about 0.4 s after the spawn and no system/init, and exited only at about 3.1 s. The measured rule: an error result before system/init is the launch failing, so the launch rejects at once, inside the 3 s window, as exited-at-once with the stderr tail, without waiting for the exit; the driver then closes stdin. The recording resumed an id that never existed; the bytes the driver reads are the same for a launch. No event reaches a consumer: the launch never resolved.
